method: Four individually authored full-body drawings from private guide poses; posterior reference style only. No sliced procedural game frames.

prompts.initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, single full-body authored animation key drawing. Produce ONE rhinoceros, not a sprite sheet.
Image1 is the main POSE and CAMERA reference, a private rough layout. Use its entire-body coordinates, side camera, animal size within full canvas, head and torso anchor. Correct the rough cutout joints; it must be a fully painted new complete drawing, no visible seams, copied blocks or stretched mesh.
Image2 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE ONLY: same friendly gray rhinoceros with two pale horns, dark shiny eye, softly faceted low-poly 3D shading, proportions. Preserve exact gray palette, horn/ear shapes, head, shoulder and hip anatomy.
Draw the single full rhino facing LEFT on genuinely transparent alpha background. Desired canvas landscape 1536x1024, about3:2 ratio, 10% transparent margin around full animal. Same fixed character framing in all pose variants: silhouette nose-to-tail horizontal extent around80% of canvas, center at50%width, shoulder at49%, hip at75%, ground line at87% canvas height. Maintain torso height and dimensions, do not recenter by changing foot position. Camera horizontal at animal's torso, same side view and lighting. All four legs fully attached, far legs slightly darker but recognizable, proper hooves, knees and elbows; tail/horns/feet fully inside canvas.
REQUIRED SPECIFIC POSE: Four-beat walk contact pose: DARK far/background FRONT leg reaches LEFT ahead of shoulder and is grounded; BRIGHT near/foreground FRONT leg angles RIGHT behind shoulder and is grounded. Near hind hoof is ahead/LEFT of hip, far hind hoof behind/RIGHT of hip. All four planted support, near and far front feet visibly separated. This is far-front leading contact.
Paint a real coherent weight-bearing rhino, heavy restrained walk, never floating or rubber joint stretching. Pose reference is rough; the four leg roles above are authoritative. No other animals, background, ground art, cast shadow, words, grid, numbers, skeletal overlays or colored guides.
prompts.hindRepairPrompt: Single rhino EDIT, not a sprite sheet. Image1 is the edit target. Preserve the EXACT face, horns, ears, torso, shoulder, hip planes, near/far FRONT legs, tail, palette, LEFT direction and1536x1024 transparent canvas. Change ONLY the TWO REAR/HIND leg articulations, replacing their old shapes cleanly. There must be exactly TWO front legs and exactly TWO hind legs, FOUR total, never add a third hind leg. Remove the old hind foot silhouette where the replacement leg no longer covers it (make vacated pixels transparent), no ghost limb, no pasted extra leg. Forelegs remain unchanged. Bright big visible-side hind leg=NEAR HIND; darker behind-body hind leg=FAR HIND.The existing BRIGHT NEAR HIND leg currently stands at the far RIGHT of the animal. Replace this near hind leg with a natural lifted passing step: flex the hip and hock, bend the lower leg forward toward LEFT under the hip; its hoof is visibly OFF THE GROUND by about8% of full image height, ahead/left of hip, attached intact to the same bright near hip root. The darker FAR HIND must remain a grounded supporting leg extending behind/RIGHT of hip. Only one rear hoof grounded. Preserve both unchanged front hooves grounded. Heavy rhino walk, three ground contacts and one lifted near hind foot. Do not retain the old bright rear-right hoof as an extra foot. No background/cast shadow.
